    Mesh relations along the covering ℤΔ → Q #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Step 1 (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex). Pull the coefficients of Q back along π. The mesh relation of ℤΔ at X maps to the mesh relation of Q at π X, so π preserves the mesh ideal; and every mesh relation of Q starting at π Z lifts to one starting at Z, so π reflects it (RelSystem.mem_ideal_of_mapPaths_mem). In particular, if paths of length at least N vanish in C(Q, c), they vanish upstairs.
